purpose: Stable cross-system contract map for converging three Flutter roots without collapsing platform/runtime boundaries.

research_api.boundary: HTTP adapter; JSON transport remains outside UI feature contracts

owner_friend.role: Owner/Control Center local-first Friend runtime adapter
owner_friend.boundary: Owner identity, session headers, local Friend runtime, and Windows service remain platform/runtime concerns

v3_runtime.boundary: V3 endpoints remain compatibility-gated until equivalent Control Center capability is verified

identity.session_boundary: session/token is owned by adapter, not UI widgets

memory.session_key_boundary: sync keys never belong in presentation widgets

orchestration.execution_boundary: UI prepares/requests; authority and execution remain external to presentation

platform.rule: runner and packaging identity are not duplicated application systems

adapter_rules: UI features depend on capability interfaces, not concrete HTTP clients.
Research API, Owner Friend API, and V3 API remain independently testable adapters.
No UI feature imports a platform runner implementation.
No migration changes Owner Special Windows identity or installer contracts.
V3 compatibility is retained until its release gates can be satisfied by the canonical shell.
JSON payloads may evolve behind adapters; stable UI contracts use normalized domain fields.
Execution and authority are never granted by the Flutter shell itself.
migration_order: wrap existing APIs with capability interfaces
migrate feature pages into canonical Control Center
verify Owner identity/installer and V3 gates
retire duplicate UI roots only after all gates close
non_goals: replace platform runners with a single runner
